title: Ask Grok About An X Post

beats: Grok explains confusing posts on X in seconds.
No need to guess what a post means anymore.
Open X and scroll to a post that needs clarity.
Get ready to ask Grok about it.
Type at grok in your reply: '@grok'.
Next, type your question. For example:
What does this mean for creators?
Send your reply to post it publicly.

lines.t: @grok What does this mean for creators?

beats: Wait a moment for Grok to respond under your reply.
Grok uses the post and context to generate an answer.
You get a clear, context-aware explanation right on X.

lines.t: Grok explains the post using its context.

beats: Follow for a new Grok tutorial every day.
